latest.title: A $C^2$-Perturbative Bernstein Theorem for Anisotropic Entire Minimal Graphs
latest.abstract: We prove a Bernstein theorem for $Φ$-anisotropic minimal hypersurfaces in dimensions $1\leq n\leq 7$ that the only entire smooth solutions $u$ of $Φ$-anisotropic minimal hypersurfaces equation are affine functions provided the anisotropic area functional integrand $Φ$ is sufficiently $C^{2}$--close to the Euclidean area integrand. This settles the $C^2$ entire--graph version of anisotropic Bernstein problem posed by Mooney and Yang \cite{MooneyYang2024}, and the proof uses a compactness--rigidity argument combined with Figalli's regularity theorem established in \cite{Figalli2017}.
latest.workSummary: 论文证明低维 entire graph 的 $C^{2}$ Bernstein 定理，利用 Gauss-image gap、变分紧性和校准/定向性排除非平面图。
latest.breakthrough: Theorem 1.1 证明 $1\le n\le 7$ 时 entire graph 必为仿射。
latest.limitations: 维数上限 $n\le 7$ 是关键；要求完整图$、C^{2}$ 正则和相应椭圆/极小曲面结构。

steps.claim: Lemmas 2.1–2.2 建立图面的 Gauss-image gap。
steps.route: 把图看作次图边界，利用一致椭圆性和法向几何证明 Gauss 映射避开特定方向锥。

steps.claim: Lemma 2.3 提供变分序列的紧性。
steps.route: 对凸一齐次 integrands 使用统一能量界，局部 L1 收敛和下半连续性提取极限图。

steps.claim: Theorem 1.1 由校准/定向性与极限刚性收束。
steps.route: 将 Gauss-image gap 与校准方向结合，证明图的梯度不能发生非平凡变化；维数 $n\le 7$ 排除奇异锥，故图为仿射。
steps.evidence: PDF 第2–4页第1节 Theorem 1.1；后续 Section 2–3 的 rigidity proof。
